In the change log, a `config_push` or `parameter_tuning` row on an aggregation router (which affects every site below it) or on each site of a group. Its status later reads `rolled_back`. The description can be bland, such as "scheduled parameter optimisation batch", so do not judge it by its wording. A step at the change time. ... What stays normal. ...
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#05] Bad change and configuration regression > Verification steps: 1. `get_anomalies` for `rrc_success_pct` and `drop_rate_pct` on a set of sites; read the start time. 2. `get_topology`: find the common ancestor of the affected sites (aggregation router or link). 3. `get_changes` for that node and its sites in the 24 hours before the onset. ... 4. `query_kpis`: confirm availability is 100 % and the RRC step is aligned with the chan...
[RB-RAN-UPGRADE-REGRESSION#02] RAN software upgrade regression > Signature in the data: A software upgrade change on a site or group of sites, executed at night. A short availability dip during the restart is expected, typically one or two steps. Persistent quality loss after the restart. Elevated `drop_rate_pct`, lower `rrc_success_pct`, and sometimes a lower volume that does not recover on the following days. ... Version-specific. ... Repeated restarts. ...
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#03] Bad change and configuration regression > Differential diagnosis: Versus the many harmless changes ... Almost all have no effect. ... A bad change leaves PRB normal or lower, latency flat, and drops RRC success. ... DNS trouble is nationwide, raises latency and leaves RRC success alone. A bad change is confined to the changed subtree, lowers RRC success and leaves latency flat. ... A fiber cut or power failure sets availability to 0. ...

result.markdown:
# RRC Success Rate Drop Caused by Parameter Tuning Regression

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-TUN-004`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct change records coincide perfectly with KPI onset and recovery, supported by runbook signatures and anomaly detections.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-12 09:30 to 2026-09-12 20:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-12 09:42
- **Affected:** S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, S-TUN-016

## Summary

A scheduled parameter optimization batch RT-2.5 applied to sites S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016 caused a configuration regression reducing RRC success rates and increasing drop rates until rolled back.

RRC success rate fell and drop rate spiked across three sites in Grand Tunis for approximately 10.5 hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-12 09:30: Traffic and RRC success drop anomaly begins across three sites. [ALR-0011]
- 2026-09-12 09:42: Parameter optimization batch RT-2.5 applied to S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016. [CHG-2026-0028, CHG-2026-0029, CHG-2026-0030]
- 2026-09-12 10:12: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-TUN-004. [ALM-000200]
- 2026-09-12 10:26: Minor RRC failure rate high alarm raised on S-TUN-016. [ALM-000202]
- 2026-09-12 19:53: Alarms cleared and impact ended following rollbacks. [ALM-000200, ALM-000202]

## Evidence

- Anomalies showed RRC success drop and drop rate spikes on S-TUN-004, S-TUN-005, and S-TUN-016 starting at 09:30. [T1]
- All three affected sites received parameter optimization batch RT-2.5 at 09:42. [T3, T5]
- The parameter tuning changes were rolled back in the evening, aligning with impact recovery. [T3, T5]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites or their ancestors during the incident window. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-TUN-004: confirmed. Parameter optimization changes matched the incident onset and recovery timings, matching runbook configuration regression signatures. [RB-BAD-CHANGE#02, CHG-2026-0028]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-02-B: rejected. Fiber link and upstream topology showed no transport failures; availability remained normal while issues were isolated to the changed subtree. [RB-BAD-CHANGE#03, T4]

## Ruled out

- T6: Maintenance window check confirmed no scheduled maintenance was active on the nodes or their ancestors.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimization batch RT-2.5 scripts to identify the specific configuration causing RRC degradation.
- Perform pre-implementation staging tests for batch parameter tuning updates before deploying across multiple sites simultaneously.

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 3 sites of LNK-TUN-02-B regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: a major alarm on LNK-TUN-02-B, the parent of the pushed sites, flaps around the onset and clears by itself, and the change record looks innocent. Settled by: (1) the alarm clears within minutes while the KPI regression goes on for hours, and availability stays at 100 %; (2) the regression starts at the change time on exactly the pushed sites and ends at the rollback; (3) the sites of the sibling links are normal.
